observations.body: Paul joins fullness in Christ, circumcision imagery, burial and raising in baptism, forgiveness, cancellation of a hostile record, and disarming rulers.
observations.label: Buried and raised with Christ while the record is removed

payload.posture: Read Colossians 2:9–15 as one movement in the resurrection, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states paul joins fullness in Christ, circumcision imagery, burial and raising in baptism, forgiveness, cancellation of a hostile record, and disarming rulers. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the resurrection.
